test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P. Despite that my guide Raj Lama sent me hiking up yet another trail to try to get a better view.

Q. I was not impressed, and I let him know.

R. I was on the Chele La mountain pass in west Bhutan.

S. The weather was ominous and it was raining too.
solution:
The correct answer is **"RSPQ".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given options are in **jumbled order **and we need to **make them in logical order.**
 
• According to the meaning, the correct order will be **RSPQ**.
 
• I was in **west Bhutan**, on the **Chele La mountain crossing**. It was **raining and the sky was gloomy**. Yet, to attempt and gain a better look, my guide **Raj Lama** had me **hiking up yet another trail**. I told him I wasn't **impressed with him**.
